name: arm6309-hardware
description: Board layouts for the arm6309 machine

scripts.check: bun run lib/slot.check.ts && bun run lib/cards.check.ts && bun run gal/mmu.check.ts && bun run gal/jedec.check.ts && bun run gal/sync.check.ts
scripts.check:sim: cd gal && verilator --binary --timing -Wall -Wno-DECLFILENAME --top-module mmu_tb mmu.v mmu_tb.sv -o mmu_tb && ./obj_dir/mmu_tb && verilator --binary --timing -Wall -Wno-DECLFILENAME --top-module clkdec_tb clkdec.v clkdec_tb.sv -o clkdec_tb && ./obj_dir/clkdec_tb
scripts.build: for f in mainboard/mainboard.circuit.tsx cards/*.circuit.tsx; do echo "-- $f"; tsci build "$f" || exit 1; done
scripts.build:all: npm run build && npm run check && npm run check:netlist && npm run check:sim
